name: clearframe-workspace
description: Agent-directed motion graphics with a native GPU renderer (Skia on Metal): display typography, honest animated charts, measured speech-following text and selective Google media.

scripts.lint: node --import tsx node_modules/oxlint/bin/oxlint apps packages tools --config .oxlintrc.json --threads=2 --max-warnings=0 --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern
scripts.lint:effect: GOMAXPROCS=2 node --import tsx node_modules/oxlint/bin/oxlint apps packages tools --config .oxlintrc.effect.json --threads=2 --max-warnings=0 --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern
scripts.format: oxfmt --check apps packages tools test scripts --threads=2
scripts.format:fix: oxfmt --write apps packages tools test scripts --threads=2
scripts.guardrails: pnpm format && pnpm lint && pnpm schemas:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint:effect && pnpm build && pnpm test:tooling && pnpm test
